name: Reslice
summary: Reslices a DWI dataset to a new isotropic voxel size with DIPY dipy_reslice (1.1.1), keeping the bvals and bvecs.
description: Runs dipy_reslice to resample a diffusion-weighted image to isotropic voxels of new_vox_size, with configurable interpolation order and boundary handling. Use it before steps that need isotropic or a specific resolution. bvals and bvecs are copied unchanged.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvals and bvecs.

outputs.description: The resliced DWI with the original bvals and bvecs.

parameters.description: Points outside the boundaries of the input are filled according to the given mode.
The value used for points outside the boundaries of the input if mode='constant'.

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
